scope: Observed diffusion geometry: conditional local-defect inequality, full observed-law entropy attainment, finite-resolution access
method: Focused web searches; primary full-text equation inspection; new journal DOI metadata cross-checked against Crossref; cumulative bibliography deduplicated.
limitations: No external peer review or laboratory validation.
Search absence is not proof of originality.
Cauchy, conditional Jensen, Markov factorization, generator decomposition, quadratic variation and regression duality are standard ingredients.

sources.title: Force-Free Kinetic Inference of Entropy Production
sources.pointers: Main Eqs. 5, 15-18; Supplement S1 Eqs. S12-S16; S4; S11-S12
sources.assessment: Closest prior: kinetic curvature plus score covariance; constant-D marginal Fisher improvement is an immediate conditional-Jensen corollary. Does not state the general conditional local-volatility weighted bound in the inspected text.
sources.redistribution: Full source not included; metadata and our analysis only.

sources.title: Variance sum rule for entropy production
sources.pointers: Main variance/entropy relation and Supplement S1-S2
sources.assessment: Prior inference from symmetric fluctuations and force/displacement variance; no first-kinetic-inference claim.
sources.redistribution: Full source not included; metadata and our analysis only.

sources.title: Equality connecting energy dissipation with violation of fluctuation-response relation
